history.content: Hi, my phone has no signal at all. Nothing loads, I can't get online, and picture messages won't go through. Can you help?

I can help you troubleshoot your phone’s signal and connectivity issues. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can assist you further.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you, Sofia. I see your line is active, so let’s start troubleshooting your phone’s signal and connectivity issues.

To proceed, I’ll need you to check your phone’s status bar for details like signal strength, airplane mode, and network type. Could you please use your phone to check the status bar and let me know what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen? This will help me identify the cause of the problem.
At the top of my screen it says 'No Signal,' but it also shows 'Data Enabled' and 'Connected to Chestnut-5G.' My battery is at 87%. There's no airplane mode icon.

Thank you for the details. Here’s what your status bar indicates:

- “No Signal” means your phone isn’t connecting to the cellular network, which explains why calls, mobile data, and picture messages aren’t working.
- “Data Enabled” means mobile data is turned on, but without signal, it won’t work.
- “Connected to Chestnut-5G” means you’re on Wi-Fi, but this doesn’t help with calls or MMS if there’s no cellular signal.
- No airplane mode icon, so airplane mode isn’t the issue.

Next, let’s check your SIM card status, as a SIM issue is a common cause of “No Signal.” Please check your SIM card status on your phone and let me know if it says “Active,” “Missing,” or “Locked.”
My SIM card status says 'Locked.' What should I do next?

Your SIM card is “Locked,” which means your phone cannot connect to the cellular network. This usually happens after entering the wrong PIN or PUK code multiple times.

For security reasons, unlocking a SIM card requires specialized support. I will transfer you to a human agent who can assist you with unlocking your SIM card.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
